description: First exchange: user says 'what is this?' while pointing at a mug (frame-002 is the referent frame; ring buffer stores it). Second exchange: user says 'what about that one?' while the current frame shows a different object (a book). The deictic gate fires on the second utterance; the grounding pass must resolve to the PRIOR referent from the ring buffer (frame-002, mug), not the current frame (book). Task 10 asserts the grounding event's caused_by traces to frame-002, not frame-100.

fixture_conventions.deictic_p: Scripted DeicticModel probability. Both utterances are deictic (>= 0.8).
fixture_conventions.scene_change_score: High score at frame-100 indicates scene transition between utterance 1 and utterance 2.
fixture_conventions.grounding_result: Stub label. 'mug' for the prior-referent resolution; 'book' would be wrong (current frame).
fixture_conventions.grounding_confidence: Stub confidence for the resolved referent.
fixture_conventions.prior_referent_frame_id: frame-002 — the raw_video_frame event_id that the second grounding must cite in caused_by.
fixture_conventions.resolution_frame: Boolean. true on the frame where the grounding pass runs. Task 10 verifies the grounding event's caused_by references the prior-referent frame, not the current frame.
fixture_conventions.frame_bytes_synthesis: raw_video frame blobs are minimal synthetic placeholders: b'\x89VID\x00' + 1 index byte.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels for human readability.

signal_trace.notes: FIRST UTTERANCE: 'what is this?' pointing at mug; ring buffer ingests this frame
first utterance frame 2; mug still visible
FIRST GROUNDING: label=mug, confidence=0.91; frame-002 is stored as the prior referent in the ring buffer
SECOND UTTERANCE: 'what about that one?'; scene changed (0.72); current frame has a book; but the referent is the PRIOR mug from frame-002
second utterance frame 2; current frame shows book

SECOND GROUNDING GATE FRAME: 'that one' resolves to the PRIOR referent (mug from frame-002) not the current frame (book). Task 10 asserts deictic_grounding.caused_by contains frame-002, not frame-101.

baseline_decisions.notes: first utterance resolves current frame (mug) confidently
second utterance resolves prior referent (mug from frame-002) NOT the current frame (book). caused_by must reference frame-002.
